newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo tea auction prices ease as volumes rise.
newsitem.headline: Colombo tea auction prices ease as volumes rise.

text.p: Colombo auction tea prices eased on poor quality and bigger volumes, brokers said on Wednesday.
"Among low grown teas, which make up the bulk of the sale quantity, a fair portion of poor teas fell on Tuesday while some high growns came down today," said a Forbes and Walker broker.
The anticipated gross sale average for the 5.6 million kg on offer fell to 98.75 rupees ($1.73) from 99.87 last week, Forbes and Walker said.
The next auction is on January 28-29 with 6.0 million kg on offer. (1$=57.06 rupees)
